zh.text: GitHub 令牌在保存 / 校验后立刻预检「能不能投稿」：索引仓库 EVEjs-mods 在维护者名下，细粒度令牌勾不到它，建 fork / 开 PR 必然 403。现在 classic 令牌按 x-oauth-scopes 看有没有 public_repo / repo，fine-grained 直接判不能，当场弹「令牌可用，但不能投稿」并给出改用 classic + public_repo 的办法；投稿链路的 403 也补上了 [方法 路径] 与权限提示（限流 403 不再被误报成权限问题）。
模组制作规范（中英双份）第 3 步重写：不再教作者建 fine-grained 令牌并把 Repository access 选 All repositories（对别人名下的索引仓库无效），改成 classic 令牌勾 public_repo，并说明细粒度令牌投稿为什么必报 403、索引仓库协作者该怎么配；常见报错表同步改正。

物品市场「简介 / 属性」页签新增「编辑属性」：直接改物品（舰船 / 装备 / 弹药…）的 dogma 属性值，不用为此停服。写的是服务端静态表 typeDogma；舰船属性另有 shipDogmaAttributes 一份副本，两份一起改，避免「属性页变了、装配里没变」。写盘前自动快照（可在静态数据页一键还原），写完用启动器的热重载把新表换进服务端内存并清掉读缓存。生效边界如实提示、不夸大：舰船属性保存后离舰再登舰就能看到新值；装备 / 物品属性在服务端有进程级缓存，多数要重启主服务器；主服务器不是本启动器拉起时，改动只在盘上、下次启动生效。

物品详情照游戏「属性」页签重排：「简介 / 属性」改名「属性」，整段是一张长表（分区标题带 + 图标 + 名称 + 右对齐的值），「装配」排到最前；标题带右侧给概要（护盾 / 装甲 / 结构是有效 HP，导航是朝向时间），护盾 / 装甲 / 结构下面一条电磁 / 热能 / 动能 / 爆炸四抗色块，感应强度改成雷达 / 光雷达 / 磁力 / 引力四格读数。舰船补上游戏里那三条只读属性 —— 质量、容量、体积（服务端静态表里没有，从 SDE 的类型数据取，「改属性」不会列出它们）。物品简介从页签里挪到标题栏的书页图标上（点开是弹窗），改属性也跟着挪成铅笔图标，与复制按钮并排。分区标题也补齐到全部在售物品：装备 / 无人机 / 舰载机用到的「炮台」「过热」「采矿」「目标标记」等分类不再露 SDE 的英文分类名（实测 49% 的在售物品原本会中一条），SDE 里没名字的分类 0 与 9（NULL）并进「其他属性」，空白标题带与 NULL 标题带都消失；四抗色块条只看抗性齐不齐 —— 损伤控制这类没有护盾容量 / 装甲值的装备照样画条，只是不给「有效 HP」读数。舰船面板的段序与改动前逐条一致。

en.text: The GitHub token panel now pre-checks whether a token can submit right after save / check: the EVEjs-mods index repository belongs to the maintainer, a fine-grained token cannot reach it, and fork + PR therefore always fail with 403. A classic token is inspected via its x-oauth-scopes header for public_repo / repo, a fine-grained one is flagged outright, and the launcher warns that the token works but submission is blocked with the classic + public_repo fix; the submit chain's 403 now carries the method/path and a permission hint too (rate-limit 403s are no longer mislabelled as a permission problem).

Rewrote step 3 of the mod authoring guide (both languages): it no longer tells authors to create a fine-grained token with Repository access set to All repositories (useless for someone else's index repository) and now recommends a classic token with public_repo, explains why a fine-grained token always 403s on submission and how index-repository collaborators should configure it, and corrects the common-errors table.

The market page's Info / Attributes tab now has Edit attributes, so item dogma values (ships, modules, charges...) can be changed without stopping the server. Values are written to the server's static typeDogma table; ships also have a copy in shipDogmaAttributes and both are updated together so the attribute panel and the fitting never disagree. A snapshot is taken before writing (restorable from the static-data page) and the launcher's hot reload swaps the new tables into the server's memory and clears its read caches. The effect is described honestly rather than oversold: ship attributes show up after undocking and boarding again, equipment / item attributes are cached per type in the server and usually need a main-server restart, and when the main server was not started by this launcher the change stays on disk and applies on the next start.

The item detail panel now follows the game's Attributes tab: the Description / Attributes tab is renamed Attributes and rendered as one long table (section header band + icon + name + right-aligned value) with Fitting first; each header carries a summary (effective HP for shield / armor / structure, align time for navigation), shield / armor / structure keep the EM / thermal / kinetic / explosive resist strip, and sensor strength became the four-cell readout (radar / ladar / magnetometric / gravimetric). Ships gained the three read-only values the game shows - mass, capacity and volume (missing from the server's static tables, read from the SDE type data; the attribute editor does not list them). The item description moved out of the tab onto a book icon in the header (opening a dialog), and Edit attributes became a pencil icon next to the copy button. Section titles now cover every listed item: the categories equipment, drones and fighters use (Turrets, Heat, Mining, Target painting and so on) no longer show the raw SDE English name (measured against the live market, 49% of listed items used to hit one), SDE's nameless categories 0 and 9 (NULL) fold into Other attributes so neither blank nor NULL header bands are drawn any more, and the resist strip now depends only on the four resistances being present - a damage control gets its shield / armor strip without a shield / armor value, just without the effective-HP readout. Ship panels keep exactly the section order they had.
